edges: Madame de Staël pays for Louis Lambert to enroll in the Collège de Vendôme.
Louis Lambert and Balzac become friends at the Collège de Vendôme.
Louis Lambert falls passionately in love with Pauline de Villenoix.
Louis Lambert experiences a moment of clarity before his wedding to Pauline.
Louis Lambert is taken to Pauline's family's château for solitude and rest.
Balzac receives letters from Louis Lambert describing his philosophical musings and love for Pauline.
Louis Lambert dies at the Villenoix château.
